raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: google-crc32c
  version: "1.9.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/google_crc32c-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 7b8c84c3d159ab6817fe3f74e6e6cef099c3f95dcec3abc0d8afb1404642efbe

build:
  number: 0
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - setuptools
    - wheel
    - libcrc32c
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - google_crc32c
      pip_check: true

about:
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Python wrapper for a hardware-based implementation of the CRC32C hashing algorithm
  description: |
    google-crc32c wraps the libcrc32c
    <https://github.com/google/crc32c> package, which is a hardware-based
    implementation of the CRC32C hashing algorithm.
  homepage: https://github.com/googleapis/python-crc32c
  repository: https://github.com/googleapis/python-crc32c
  documentation: https://github.com/googleapis/python-crc32c

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - tswast
    - xylar
